applicant_utility.summary: A three-month, email-submitted fellowship that places OIC-based biomedical scientists into a virology or vaccine-technology centre of excellence in another OIC country. The package is travel plus board: COMSTECH pays low-cost international airfare and the host provides subsistence, supervision and mentoring - there is no stipend and no tuition payment. Because only one COMSTECH programme application is allowed per calendar year, treat this as a once-a-year shot and get your institution head's supporting statement and two senior referees lined up before you send anything.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Biomedical or health-science researchers aged 35 or under (45 for post-graduates) employed at an OIC research institution, holding an M.S. or PhD in a biomedical or health science.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the head of your home institution will write the supporting statement, and identify two senior referees who are not the head
Keep a five-page CV with publications ready
Complete the official form linked from the COMSTECH page
Email the form plus passport copy, CV, head-of-institution statement, two reference letters and degree transcripts to khazima@comstech.org or comstech@comstech.org
common_rejection_risks: The head of the home institution acting as a referee - explicitly disallowed
A CV longer than five pages
Applying for two COMSTECH programmes in the same calendar year
An illegible passport name page (expired passports are accepted, but the page must scan clearly)
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Only international low-cost airfare and host-provided subsistence are published; there is no stipend and no tuition or enrolment-fee coverage, so insurance, personal costs and any host fees are self-funded.
document_audit: Scanned passport page showing name and surname - expired copies accepted
Two reference letters must come from senior scientists familiar with your work
The supporting statement from the head of your home institution is a hard requirement
M.S./Ph.D. degrees and relevant university transcripts must be included in the same email
alerts: Only one COMSTECH programme application per calendar year - applying elsewhere in COMSTECH makes you ineligible here
The call is currently open with no published closing date, so timing is set by when you choose to apply
Preference goes to women scientists, those early in their career, and those working in OIC least-developed countries or Muslim-majority areas in non-OIC states
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the form linked from the COMSTECH page and email it with the supporting documents to COMSTECH Headquarters in Islamabad; a joint expert committee of COMSTECH and the host institutions reviews applications.
